f783e67526a97ff3.description: About Arada Arada develops communities designed to inspire healthier, happier, and more meaningful lives. The company focuses on innovative developments, customer experiences, and a commitment to sustainability, aiming to create environments where individuals can live, work, and thrive. Joining Arada means becoming part of a collaborative and ambitious team dedicated to delivering excellence across all business aspects. Role Overview Arada is seeking a Design Director to lead and manage the complete design process for multiple developments in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing projects from feasibility and concept through detailed design, authority approvals, and construction support. The Design Director will coordinate multidisciplinary consultants, ensure design excellence, meet programmed commitments, and deliver commercially viable solutions aligned with Arada's development vision and brand standards. The Director will report within the Design function and collaborate closely with Development, Project Controls, Commercial, and Delivery teams. Key Responsibilities Lead the design and delivery of large-scale residential, hospitality, retail, commercial, mixed-use, and master-planned developments across Saudi Arabia. Oversee the full project lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design through detailed design, construction support, and project completion. Drive design excellence, innovation, sustainability, and ESG initiatives while ensuring commercial viability and operational success. Manage and coordinate architectural, engineering, landscape, infrastructure, and specialist consultants across multiple projects. Partner with Development, Commercial, Procurement, Legal, Infrastructure, and Sales & Marketing teams to align design solutions with business objectives. Establish and maintain design governance, quality assurance, value engineering, and technical compliance processes. Ensure projects comply with Saudi regulations, authority requirements, and international best practices. Lead design reviews, stakeholder presentations, authority approvals, and multidisciplinary coordination workshops. Support project procurement, tendering, contractor selection, and construction delivery through technical leadership and guidance. Mentor and develop Design Managers and Architects, championing collaboration, innovation, and Arada’s design vision across the KSA portfolio. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in design leadership roles. Demonstrated ability to manage complex design processes across multiple large-scale developments. Experience coordinating multidisciplinary consultants and ensuring design excellence. Strong understanding of commercial viability and operational success in development projects. Work Environment and Schedule This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring a commitment of 40 hours per week. The role involves close collaboration with various internal teams and external consultants to successfully execute projects across Saudi Arabia.

f7aaaf12d62567cc.description: مساعد طبيب أسنان في مترو ميد تبحث شركة مترو ميد عن مساعد طبيب أسنان للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، ويهدف إلى دعم أطباء الأسنان في تقديم رعاية عالية الجودة للمرضى. نبذة عن الدور يتولى مساعد طبيب الأسنان مسؤولية تقديم الدعم الشامل لطبيب الأسنان، بدءًا من استقبال المرضى وحتى المساعدة في الإجراءات العلاجية، بالإضافة إلى ضمان جاهزية العيادة والأدوات. يركز الدور على الكفاءة التشغيلية ورعاية المرضى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال المرضى وإجلاسهم على كرسي طب الأسنان، مع توثيق بياناتهم الشخصية في ملفاتهم. تنظيف وتطهير وتعقيم الأجهزة والأدوات المستخدمة في عيادة الأسنان، بالإضافة إلى تفقد وتشغيل كرسي الأسنان. تحضير المواد السنية المطلوبة وخلط الحشوات المؤقتة والدائمة للأسنان، وخلط المواد العازلة. مساعدة طبيب الأسنان أثناء عمله من خلال مناولته الأدوات والمواد وسحب اللعاب. تفقد أدوات ومعدات العمل وتنظيفها، وتخزين مواد الأسنان وفقًا لظروف التخزين المناسبة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال مساعد طبيب الأسنان. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

f7acb3491514491d.description: About the Role Dome Arabia Environmental Consulting Company is seeking an experienced Data and Operational Performance Analyst to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is open to Saudi nationals with 5-10 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The Data and Operational Performance Analyst supports operational monitoring and improvement initiatives. This involves collecting, analyzing, and reporting on inspection and complaint data. The role focuses on transforming operational records into clear findings, tracking key performance indicators, and preparing reports to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement processes. Key Responsibilities Collect and organize inspection, complaint, and related operational data into a consistent format for analysis and reporting. Review incoming records for completeness and consistency, identifying missing information or discrepancies that could impact results. Analyze inspection and complaint data to identify trends, recurring issues, and changes in operational performance. Monitor agreed performance indicators and maintain clear records of results over time. Compare reporting periods and explain significant movements, patterns, and exceptions within the underlying data. Prepare operational reports that clearly present results, supported by relevant tables, charts, and written observations. Maintain organized analysis files and supporting records to ensure reported figures can be traced to their source. Review findings with relevant teams and clarify data or operational information needed to complete analyses. Identify practical opportunities for improvement based on inspection results, complaint trends, and performance findings. f7908dcec0abb763.description: About the Role DHL is seeking a National Retail Manager to oversee the performance, operations, and development of the DHL Express Retail business across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Achieve national Retail revenue, profitability, shipment growth, and customer acquisition targets. Act as the single point of ownership and escalation for all Retail matters within the country. Develop and execute the national Retail strategy in alignment with DHL Express commercial priorities. Oversee the performance and operation of every DHL Retail service point in Saudi Arabia, ensuring commercial viability and operational effectiveness. Ensure all Retail locations comply with DHL policies, security requirements, and customs regulations. Lead, develop, and engage the national Retail organization across all regions and locations. Manage the national strategy, performance, governance, and development of DHL sales partners and authorized resellers. Represent DHL with landlords, contractors, and service providers regarding service point premises and facility requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including Operations, Customer Service, Finance, and Marketing to resolve Retail challenges. Sponsor and oversee national Retail programs and strategic projects, including transformation and digitalization initiatives. f736c4ea3a1e8028.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Production Engineer Welding to join their team in Ras Tannurah, Eastern region. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on overseeing welding operations to ensure project specifications and industry standards are met. Supervise and lead a team of welding workers and supervisors, ensuring all welding activities adhere to project specifications and industry standards. Assist in PQR and WQT for projects by coordinating with relevant stakeholders. Ensure pre and post-heating requirements are carried out based on material thickness, grade, and project specifications. Conduct inspections, resolve issues, and monitor welding and rectification works. Maintain required inventory levels of welding consumables. f7687685117d5a7d.description: About the Role Mina Excellence is seeking a Senior Internal Auditor to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves planning and conducting risk-based internal audits to evaluate the effectiveness of financial controls, operational processes, corporate governance, risk management, and compliance practices. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The Senior Internal Auditor will contribute to strengthening the organization's internal audit framework. This includes identifying control weaknesses and financial risks, providing objective assessments, and offering practical recommendations. The primary goal is to safeguard organizational assets, enhance accountability, and improve overall operational effectiveness. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute an annual risk-based internal audit plan covering financial, operational, governance, and compliance activities. Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls, risk management practices, and corporate governance frameworks. Review financial reporting controls, accounting processes, and procedures to ensure accuracy, reliability, and compliance with applicable standards. Assess controls over budgeting, treasury, cash management, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll, fixed assets, and financial closing. Evaluate expenditure approvals, payment authorizations, bank reconciliations, segregation of duties, and compliance with delegated authorities. Conduct audits of procurement, supplier management, contracts, and other critical business processes to identify control weaknesses, inefficiencies, and financial risks. Assess compliance with applicable laws, regulations, corporate policies, procedures, and approved governance frameworks. Identify potential fraud risks, financial irregularities, and control deficiencies, recommending appropriate corrective and preventive measures. Prepare comprehensive internal audit reports outlining key findings, risk exposure, root causes, and practical recommendations. Communicate significant audit findings and risk-related matters to the designated oversight authority and relevant stakeholders. Monitor and verify the implementation of agreed corrective actions to ensure timely resolution of audit findings. Coordinate with external auditors and recommend improvements to strengthen internal controls, risk management, and operational effectiveness. f769e8ba330e3080.description: About the Role Cipher7 Business Consulting & Digital Solutions is seeking a Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Supervisor to join their team in Makkah, serving both Jeddah and Makkah. f77c256111ce3444.description: About the Role KUN Investment Holding (KIH) is seeking a Senior Investment Analyst to join its Financial Investments department. f790a54883f58faa.description: About the Role Accenture Middle East is seeking a Business Continuity Crisis & Cyber Resilience Senior Manager to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves leading the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the organization’s Business Continuity Management (BCM), Crisis Management, Operational Resilience, and Cyber Recovery capabilities. The Senior Manager will ensure the organization can effectively prepare for, respond to, recover from, and adapt to business disruptions, cyber incidents, operational failures, and major crises. Key Responsibilities Lead the Business Continuity Management (BCM) framework, including policies, standards, governance, and lifecycle. Conduct and oversee Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and Risk Assessments, identifying critical business processes, dependencies, impacts, Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs), and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs). Develop, maintain, and test Business Continuity Plans (BCP), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRP), and recovery strategies. Lead the design and implementation of Crisis Management frameworks, including crisis response structures, escalation protocols, crisis communications, and executive decision-making processes. Develop and maintain Crisis Management Plans (CMP) and coordinate crisis simulations and exercises with senior leadership. Establish and manage Incident Management capabilities, including incident response, escalation, command-and-control, stakeholder coordination, and post-incident reviews. Lead Cyber Recovery and Cyber Resilience planning, ensuring critical business services can recover following ransomware, cyberattacks, data compromise, system outages, and other technology-related disruptions. Coordinate with Cybersecurity, IT, Technology, Risk, Internal Audit, Compliance, and business functions to align cyber recovery and technology disaster recovery capabilities. Develop and test Cyber Recovery Plans, including recovery priorities, clean-room/recovery environments, backup and restoration strategies, critical applications, infrastructure, and data dependencies. Establish Operational Resilience frameworks covering critical business services, people, processes, technology, facilities, suppliers, and third-party dependencies. Design and lead BCM, crisis management, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, and incident response exercises, including tabletop exercises and simulation scenarios. Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory, industry, and international standards, including ISO 22301, ISO 27001, NIST, DORA, and applicable regulatory requirements. Lead third-party and supplier resilience assessments, including Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) requirements. Provide senior management and executive committees with reporting on organizational resilience, critical risks, preparedness, gaps, and remediation. Lead continuous improvement through lessons learned, post-incident reviews, root-cause analysis, scenario analysis, and resilience testing. Manage BCM and resilience teams, consultants, vendors, and strategic transformation initiatives. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Risk Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. 5-10 years of proven experience in Business Continuity Management (BCM), Operational Resilience, Disaster Recovery, Crisis Management, Cyber Resilience, Risk Management, or related disciplines. Proven experience developing and implementing enterprise-wide BCM, Crisis Management, and Operational Resilience frameworks. Hands-on experience conducting Business Impact Analysis (BIA), risk assessments, and defining recovery strategies, including RTOs and RPOs. Experience designing, testing, and maintaining Business Continuity Plans (BCP), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRP), and Crisis Management Plans (CMP). Strong understanding of Incident Management, Crisis Response, and Major Incident Handling processes. Experience working with senior leadership and executive committees during crisis situations, resilience exercises, and decision-making events. Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across Technology, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Business functions. Experience developing resilience metrics, KPIs/KRIs, governance reporting, and maturity assessments. Strong project and program management capabilities, with experience leading cross-functional teams and strategic initiatives. Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Information Security, Risk Management, Cybersecurity, or a related field. Professional certifications such as CBCI, MBCI, CBCP, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, PMP, or ITIL Foundation or higher. Experience within highly regulated industries such as Financial Services, Banking, Telecommunications, Energy, Aviation, Healthcare, or Government. Experience implementing resilience programs aligned with ISO 22301, ISO 27001, NIST, DORA, and other regulatory frameworks. Knowledge of cyber recovery technologies, ransomware recovery strategies, backup and recovery solutions, and clean-room recovery environments. Experience leading enterprise-wide crisis simulations, tabletop exercises, and operational resilience testing programs. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. f711b3de469245fd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة الوطنية للصناعات الميكانيكية عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. سيساهم المهندس الميكانيكي في تصميم وتطوير وتنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة الجوانب الفنية والتجارية المتعلقة بمنتجات الشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الهندسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. وضع خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات التجارية البحث عن عملاء جدد ومتابعة العملاء الحاليين، بما في ذلك المقاولون، الاستشاريون، المصانع، والجهات الحكومية. دراسة الاحتياجات الفنية للعملاء واختيار المضخات المناسبة، مع تحديد معدل التدفق (Flow)، ارتفاع الضخ (Head)، والقدرة المطلوبة. قراءة المواصفات الفنية وجداول الكميات (BOQ) ومطابقتها مع منتجات الشركة. إعداد العروض الفنية والمالية والرد على استفسارات العملاء والاستشاريين. المشاركة في المناقصات ومتابعة اعتماد المواد (Material Submittal) لدى الاستشاريين. التفاوض مع العملاء على الأسعار والشروط حتى إتمام الصفقات. متابعة أوامر الشراء مع إدارات الإنتاج والمشتريات والمالية حتى التسليم. تحديث سجل الفرص البيعية ورفع تقارير شهرية بالمبيعات والتوقعات. رصد تحركات المنافسين وأسعارهم في السوق. تحقيق المستهدف البيعي المعتمد للدور. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة جامعية في الهندسة الميكانيكية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ التصميم الميكانيكي وأنظمة التدفئة والتبريد. القدرة على قراءة وتحليل المواصفات الفنية وجداول الكميات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والعرض والتفاوض. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء والاستشاريين. مهارات تحليلية وحل المشكلات. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستتاح الفرصة للمهندس الميكانيكي للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في مشاريع حيوية للشركة الوطنية للصناعات الميكانيكية.

f742613e4b27da52.description: About the Role Connexa Recruitment is seeking an experienced BIM Manager specializing in Structural Steel Buildings to join an established Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AEC) consultancy in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Understand system architecture and operational requirements for Master System Integration of all MEPH, ICT, ELV, FLS, Security, and AV systems. Manage integrated systems testing and end-to-end commissioning of interconnected assets. Coordinate commissioning activities between contractors, stakeholders, operators, and authorities. Oversee the review and approval of commissioning procedures, test scripts, and handover documentation. Monitor commissioning readiness across design, procurement, construction, and operations interfaces. Ensure compliance with health, safety, quality, and environmental requirements. Lead the resolution of commissioning and operational performance issues. Support operational readiness and transition activities with end users and operators. Provide leadership and mentoring to commissioning teams across multiple workstreams. Responsibilities and Values Promote Mace's value of Safety First, exhibiting visible safety behaviors and sharing lessons learned. Possess technical expertise in local health and safety rules and regulations relevant to the project portfolio. Promote a diverse and inclusive working environment and support team wellbeing. Ensure robust quality systems are in place and managed in line with service excellence. Manage project budgets, highlighting risks, challenges, and mitigations. Support the long-term development of the function or Business Unit, creating a sustainable business future. Manage design and wider consultant teams collaboratively to ensure effective completion of responsibilities. Lead and manage the project team and relevant stakeholders to achieve strategic project key performance indicators (KPIs). Actively network, innovate, and seek best practice, utilizing Mace Group's knowledge resources. Core Competencies and Requirements Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills. Commercial and delivery awareness within complex, multidisciplinary programs. Ability to work effectively in a remote site environment and manage competing priorities. Commitment to health, safety, quality, sustainability, and collaborative working. A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Application Information Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Applicants are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet every criterion, as they may still be suitable for this or other roles within the organization. Discussions regarding part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options are also open if suitable for the role.

f71cea98cf3958ee.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع سينان لطب الأسنان عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقه في بريدة، القصيم. يشارك شاغل الوظيفة في تطوير أهداف الشؤون الإدارية ويشرف على تخطيط وتنظيم وتنفيذ الأعمال الإدارية وفق الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة، مع ضمان توفر الموارد اللازمة لسير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف والخطط والبرامج الخاصة بالشؤون الإدارية، ومتابعة تنفيذها وقياس مدى تحقيقها. الإشراف على تطوير ومراجعة السياسات والإجراءات والصلاحيات الإدارية لضمان كفاءة وسرعة تقديم الخدمات. الإشراف على الخدمات الإدارية والتشغيلية بالمجمع، بما في ذلك الموارد البشرية، المراسلات، الأرشفة، النظافة، الصيانة، الأمن والمرافق. متابعة احتياجات الأقسام والموظفين من الموارد البشرية والتقنية والمستلزمات الإدارية، وضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب. التأكد من تطبيق الأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية المعتمدة وإبلاغ الموظفين بها ومتابعة الالتزام بتنفيذها. التنسيق بين الأقسام المختلفة وحل المعوقات والمشكلات التي تؤثر في سير العمل. متابعة أداء الموظفين الإداريين وتوزيع المهام وتقييم مستوى الإنجاز وفق الصلاحيات المعتمدة. إعداد ورفع التقارير الدورية عن أداء الشؤون الإدارية، ونسب الإنجاز، والتحديات، والاحتياجات إلى الإدارة العليا. متابعة شكاوى المرضى والموظفين المتعلقة بالجوانب الإدارية، واتخاذ الإجراءات المناسبة لمعالجتها. متابعة تطبيق متطلبات الجودة والسلامة والأنظمة ذات العلاقة بالمنشآت الصحية ضمن نطاق الشؤون الإدارية. القيام بأي مهام أخرى ذات صلة وفق توجيهات الإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. الموقع بريدة، القصيم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن.

f7454cb61de575a0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دبيب للتأجير عن مشرف عقار للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإدارة المتكاملة ومتابعة محفظة العقارات، بهدف رفع نسبة الإشغال وتحسين العائد مع الحفاظ على جودة العقارات. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة ومتابعة العقارات والمستأجرين بشكل يومي. إعداد ومتابعة وتجديد عقود الإيجار عبر منصة إيجار. متابعة تحصيل الإيجارات والمتأخرات واتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة. تسويق وتأجير الوحدات الشاغرة ومتابعة المعاينات. متابعة طلبات الصيانة والتنسيق مع الفنيين والمقاولين حتى إغلاقها. الحصول على عروض الأسعار ومقارنتها ومتابعة جودة التنفيذ. استلام وتسليم الوحدات وتوثيق حالتها. متابعة الإيرادات والمصروفات الخاصة بكل عقار. تنظيم وحفظ العقود والفواتير والمستندات. زيارة العقارات وإجراء فحص دوري وتحديد المشكلات والملاحظات. متابعة الخدمات والمرافق والجهات ذات العلاقة بالعقار. رفع تقرير دوري عن الإشغال والتحصيل والعقود والصيانة والمصروفات. اقتراح وتنفيذ مبادرات لرفع دخل العقارات وتقليل الشواغر والمصاريف. تحمل مسؤولية متابعة ملف العقارات من بداية المهمة حتى إغلاقها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال إدارة العقارات أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على إدارة ومتابعة محفظة عقارية بشكل متكامل. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتفاوض. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف العقار في مدينة الرياض ضمن فريق شركة دبيب للتأجير، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب متابعة مستمرة للعقارات والمستأجرين. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

f7739649811aaf90.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن إطفائي ذي خبرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل مسؤولية قيادة فرق الإطفاء والإنقاذ، والاستجابة لحوادث الطائرات والمباني، بالإضافة إلى ضمان جاهزية المعدات وتدريب الأفراد. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة فرق الإطفاء والإنقاذ والاستجابة الفورية لحوادث الطائرات والمباني. تشغيل مركبات ومعدات الإطفاء بكفاءة عالية. التنسيق الفعال مع برج المراقبة ومركز الطوارئ لضمان استجابة سريعة ومنظمة. الإشراف على جاهزية المركبات والمعدات، وتدريب أفراد الفريق بشكل دوري. الاستجابة لإنذارات الحرائق ومكالمات الطوارئ بأقصى سرعة وفعالية ممكنة. تقييم ظروف الحرائق وإطفائها باستخدام المعدات والأجهزة اللازمة مثل عربات الإطفاء، ومضخات وخراطيم المياه. تحديد أماكن الضحايا وإخلائهم من المباني المحترقة ومواقع الحوادث، وتقديم الإسعافات الأولية اللازمة. تفتيش مواقع الحرائق بعد إخماد النيران لمنع انتشار المواد الخطرة أو الحد من انتشارها. المشاركة في توعية الجمهور حول كيفية الوقاية من الحرائق وأساليب حماية الأرواح والممتلكات. إعداد تقارير الإنجاز الفنية ورفعها بشكل دوري إلى المسؤول المختص. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 10 سنوات في مجال الإطفاء والإنقاذ. القدرة على قيادة الفرق والعمل تحت الضغط في حالات الطوارئ. معرفة واسعة بأنظمة ومعدات الإطفاء الحديثة. مهارات تواصل وتنسيق ممتازة. بيئة العمل يعمل الإطفائي ضمن فريق متخصص في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالعمل بدوام كامل والاستعداد للاستجابة السريعة لحالات الطوارئ. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

f7a2dc5f3d0367d8.description: About Botanica Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global's destinations. The company integrates new species with local flora, benefiting from shared strategic goals and collaborative initiatives within the Red Sea Global group. Operating over 1 million square meters, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants since 2020, with a goal of 30 million by 2030, shaping the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. The team includes 40% from the local community, committed to ecological harmony and pioneering sustainable development benchmarks. Role Summary Botanica is seeking a Director Commercial to lead its commercial function. This full-time role is based in Tabuk, specifically covering Umluj and Tabuk, and requires over 10 years of experience. The Director Commercial will be responsible for growing profitable, contracted revenue across all business lines, including plant and tree supply, contract growing, nursery services, horticultural soil, indoor plants and flowers, agricultural consulting, and landscape maintenance services. The role involves owning the commercial strategy, pricing, tendering, client contracts, and key accounts for both internal clients within Red Sea Global and external developments. The Director Commercial is accountable for ensuring that all client commitments are deliverable by business units and are margin-positive for Botanica. Key Responsibilities Develop the 3–5 year commercial strategy and annual revenue plan, aligned with the Botanica business plan and Red Sea Global Group priorities. Define the product and service portfolio and pricing architecture for each business line. Lead market research and competitor benchmarking; identify new segments and services. Provide monthly demand forecasts to the PMO for sales and operations planning. Build and manage the opportunity pipeline across internal Red Sea Global clients and external developments. Chair bid/no-bid reviews; lead tender strategy and proposal preparation with input from Production, PMO, and Finance. Approve cost build-ups and price-to-win jointly with Finance; ensure proposals meet margin floors. Develop strategic partnerships, distribution channels, and B2B/B2C sales routes for specific products. Own client relationships for all key accounts, internal and external; maintain account plans, SLAs, and periodic performance reviews. Lead negotiation, execution, and renewal of client contracts; manage variations, change orders, and claims. Ensure monthly invoices are backed by verified service evidence jointly with Production. Own account-level collections with Finance; resolve disputed invoices and protect days sales outstanding. Track sales, revenue, and margin against plan; report variances and recovery actions monthly. Lead marketing plans that position Botanica as a trusted supplier, overseeing the plant catalogue, sales collateral, and digital presence. Plan and deliver Botanica tours and visitor experiences for guests, partners, and clients. Build and lead the commercial team, setting objectives, KPIs, and succession plans, including Saudization targets. Own commercial policies, including pricing approval matrix, credit terms, and anti-bribery controls. Follow and enforce all relevant Botanica and Red Sea Global Group policies, processes, and standards. Apply and champion safety, quality, and environmental management systems. Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in departmental systems and practices. Experience and Qualifications Over 10 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to lead commercial functions and drive revenue growth. Experience in developing and implementing commercial strategies, pricing, and tendering processes. Proficiency in managing client contracts and key accounts. Understanding of sales and operations planning, demand forecasting, and financial reporting. Experience in marketing and brand positioning within a B2B and B2C context. Leadership experience in building and managing commercial teams. Knowledge of relevant industry standards (*, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 37301) is beneficial. Work Context Botanica operates as an integrated landscape company with two primary revenue engines: project-based product sales (plants, trees, soil, indoor plants, and flowers) and recurring services (landscape maintenance, nursery management, and consulting). This role serves both internal clients within Red Sea Global and external developments, including hotel operators, developers, and government entities. The Director Commercial must balance growth objectives with the delivery capabilities of the Production units. Key commercial risks include concentration on internal Red Sea Global clients, price pressure on maintenance renewals, and scope creep, which the role must identify and address proactively.

f7d7f429c331d480.description: نبحث عن عامل مستودع ملتزم ونشيط للانضمام إلى فريقنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن استلام البضائع وتخزينها وتنظيمها بكفاءة، بالإضافة إلى المساعدة في عمليات الجرد والشحن. نقدم بيئة عمل محفزة وفرصًا للتطور المهني. مهام ومسؤوليات الوظيفة: * استلام وفحص البضائع الواردة والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات. * ترتيب وتخزين المنتجات في المستودع بشكل منهجي وآمن. * المشاركة في عمليات الجرد الدورية للمخزون. * تجهيز الطلبات للشحن والتأكد من دقتها. * الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل.

f77c686bd96e0c98.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تعلن مؤسسة اهتمامات لامعه للتجارة عن توفر وظيفة مشرف نظافة في مدينة الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف المباشر على عمليات النظافة للمنازل والمكاتب، وضمان تقديم خدمات عالية الجودة. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال شركات النظافة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على أعمال نظافة المنازل والمكاتب. متابعة أداء فريق عمال النظافة وتوجيههم. تنظيم جداول العمل لضمان كفاءة سير العمل. التأكد من تطبيق معايير النظافة والجودة المطلوبة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة سابقة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال شركات النظافة. خبرة فعلية ومثبتة في الإشراف على أعمال نظافة المنازل والمكاتب. القدرة على متابعة العمال وتنظيم جداول العمل بفعالية. حسن التعامل مع فريق العمل والعملاء. القدرة على تحمل ضغط العمل. ملاحظة هامة نعتذر عن قبول المتقدمين الذين لا يملكون خبرة فعلية ومباشرة في شركات النظافة المتخصصة في خدمات البيوت والمكاتب. تفاصيل الوظيفة نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. موقع العمل: الرياض. التقديم للمهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

f77db981b016b988.job_title: Project Manager / Senior Project Manager Infrastructure
f77db981b016b988.description: About the Role Mace is seeking a Senior Project Manager Infrastructure Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, KSA. This full-time role involves providing project management consultancy services for a large luxury mixed-use development. The position requires over 10 years of experience in infrastructure project management. Role Overview The Senior Project Manager Infrastructure Specialist will provide strategic leadership across complex infrastructure projects. This includes ensuring integrated planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery assurance. The role leverages extensive project management expertise and technical insight to achieve safe, high-quality outcomes that meet programme objectives, budget requirements, and delivery commitments. Key Responsibilities Champion safety, wellbeing, inclusivity, and responsible delivery across all projects. Deliver projects through clear planning, quality systems, and strong stakeholder collaboration. Supervise change and commercial performance with integrity. Lead teams to achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), share best practices, and unlock potential within Mace. Lead infrastructure delivery from strategy and mobilisation through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout. Establish governance, controls, risk, cost, programme, and reporting disciplines to support confident delivery. Integrate technical teams, consultants, contractors, and authorities to manage interfaces and dependencies. Promote Mace's value of Safety First, exhibiting visible safety behaviours, sharing lessons learned, and utilising safety moments and Mace's HSW framework. Ensure robust quality systems are in place and managed in line with service excellence. Manage project delivery from inception through design development, planning, contractor procurement, and construction phase, in accordance with the overall delivery program and agreed project milestones. Manage project budgets and identify risks, challenges, and mitigations. Manage design and wider consultant teams collaboratively to ensure effective completion of responsibilities. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience in project management, specifically within infrastructure. Technical expertise in local health and safety rules and regulations relevant to project portfolios. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage project teams and relevant stakeholders to achieve strategic project KPIs. Experience in actively networking, innovating, and seeking best practices, utilising knowledge resources such as Mace Group, Centres of Excellence, Mace Way Control Centre, and Knowledge Hub. Company Values Mace operates on core values that guide its operations and culture: Safety first - Going home safe and well: Championing a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, with an understanding of wellbeing importance. Client focus - Deliver on our promise: Owning the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes, and building long-term client relationships. Integrity - Always do the right thing: Influencing positive outcomes within the industry while aligning with compliance obligations. Create opportunity - For our people to excel: Championing a continuous improvement culture to inspire people and teams to develop. Work Environment Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. The company is open to discussing part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options where suitable for the role.

f7fbc9efa1aecc8d.description: About the Opportunity Abdullah Hashim Co. Ltd is seeking a Tamheer Opportunity Marketing Specialist for a full-time position in Jeddah, Makkah. This role is designed for motivated individuals eager to gain hands-on experience and grow within the marketing field, with a focus on developing practical skills and contributing to marketing initiatives. Role Overview The Marketing Specialist will be responsible for supporting the development and execution of marketing strategies. This involves engaging in various marketing activities, from content creation to campaign analysis, and collaborating with internal and external teams to achieve marketing objectives. The position is suitable for fresh graduates with 0-1 years of experience who are eligible for the Tamheer Program. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute marketing strategies and campaigns across digital and traditional channels. Conduct market research, analyze campaign performance, and provide actionable insights. Create and manage marketing content while ensuring brand consistency across all platforms. Coordinate promotional events, product launches, and collaborate with internal teams and external partners. Manage the marketing budget, maintain digital platforms, and support the sales team with marketing initiatives. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. Fresh graduate with 0-1 years of experience. Eligibility for the Tamheer Program is required. Required Skills Good communication and interpersonal skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Strong organizational and coordination abilities. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements and are eager to gain practical experience in marketing are encouraged to apply for this Tamheer opportunity.

f749a2be89d25808.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Sales Coordinator to join its team in Medina, Al Madinah. This full-time role involves supporting sales operations, generating leads, and contributing to new business development within the hospitality sector. The Sales Coordinator plays a key role in ensuring efficient team operations and delivering guest experiences. Responsibilities Perform daily sales operations, including administrative support, data entry, invoice distribution, Salesforce activity tracking, and recordkeeping. Support sales documentation and reporting by assisting with contracts, proposals, RFP responses, client call summaries, and booking and loyalty reports. Generate and qualify new business leads through research, identification, and evaluation of unmanaged and prospect accounts to build and maintain a qualified pipeline. Build collaborative relationships with Hilton Worldwide Sales peers, customers, and hotel partners to identify and qualify new opportunities, conduct discovery calls for unmanaged accounts, and deliver tailored solutions. Assist with special projects and events, supporting departmental initiatives, customer engagement activities, and participation in meetings and conferences as needed. Required Qualities Candidates should demonstrate the following core values: A commitment to Hospitality. Acting with Integrity. Demonstrating Leadership. Belief in Teamwork for optimal outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. A focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to tasks. Experience and Work Type This role requires 0-1 years of experience. It is a full-time position within the Hilton Hotels team. About Hilton Hilton is a global hospitality leader recognized for its workplace culture. The company focuses on delivering experiences for guests and fostering an environment for its team members. Hilton has received recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune.

f773eca0715685af.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Front Office Receptionist in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is central to ensuring a smooth and welcoming experience for all guests, from check-in to check-out. The Front Office Receptionist contributes to guest satisfaction by providing efficient service and comprehensive hotel information. Key Responsibilities Greet guests upon arrival and manage the check-in process, including verifying details, assigning rooms, issuing keys, and offering welcome materials or bell service assistance. Process guest departures efficiently, verifying charges, handling payments, issuing receipts, and accurately utilizing the point-of-sale system. Provide detailed knowledge of hotel offerings, room types, rates, promotions, and local area information to assist with guest inquiries. Apply up-selling techniques to recommend hotel amenities and maximize revenue from rooms and services. Respond to guest requests, resolve concerns promptly and with care, and manage messages and communications effectively. Required Qualifications Candidates should possess 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Hilton values specific qualities in its team members, which are essential for success in this role: A commitment to Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and consistently making appropriate decisions. Demonstrating Leadership by inspiring others. Belief in Teamwork to achieve optimal results. A sense of Ownership and accountability for tasks. Focus on the Now, applying urgency and discipline to every moment to ensure lasting impact. About Hilton Hilton is a global hospitality leader recognized for its award-winning workplace culture. The company has welcomed over 3 billion guests worldwide, maintaining its vision to provide exceptional hospitality. Hilton has received repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune, setting standards for the future of travel with its portfolio of brands and commitment to guest experience. Career Development Hilton supports career development at every stage, whether individuals are starting their careers or exploring new opportunities. The company encourages team members to grow within the organization.

f7d37710471748c8.company_name: King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre
f7d37710471748c8.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking an ICU Specialist to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah. This is a full-time position for professionals with 5-10 years of experience. The role focuses on providing high-quality patient care within the Intensive Care Unit, adhering to established standards and protocols. Key Responsibilities Provide patient care in accordance with granted privileges, standards of care, and Fakeeh Care policies. Document all provided care as per Fakeeh Care documentation policies and procedures. Educate and communicate effectively with patients, collaborating with the attending physician for in-patients. Perform or assist in medical/surgical procedures as delineated in granted privileges. Provide patients with requested medical reports in a timely manner and according to Fakeeh Care format. Attend departmental meetings and scientific activities, contributing to the teaching and training of junior staff. Develop a thorough understanding of Fakeeh Care policies and procedures and effectively participate in their execution. Educate patients and their families about health conditions, treatments, and preventative measures. Perform other duties as assigned within the scope of responsibility and job requirements. Commitment to Continuous Improvement All Fakeeh Care employees are expected to contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and adherence to organizational values. This includes performing duties in a manner that supports Fakeeh’s Person-Centered care values and actively contributing to improvement initiatives within the scope of the role. Professional Standards and Compliance Adhere to safety protocols and proactively address any job-related safety concerns. Maintain strict confidentiality of all sensitive information accessed or encountered during work. Uphold Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies, and ethical standards. Complete mandatory education requirements at least one month prior to expiration. Experience Required Candidates for the ICU Specialist position should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in intensive care. f7434243f6444106.description: الغرض من الوظيفة  المحافظة على أمن وسالمة المنشأة وممتلكاتها والعاملين والزوار، ومراقبة الدخول والخروج، والابلاغ عن أي ملاحظات أو مخالفات أو حالات طارئة. المهام والمسئوليات المهام والمسئوليات الرئيسية: مراقبة مداخل ومخارج المنشأة والتأكد من تنظيم حركة الدخول والخروج . التأكد من هوية الزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم حسب الاجراءات المعتمدة . القيام بجولات تفقدية دورية داخل الموقع للتأكد من السالمة والامن . متابعة كاميرات المراقبة والابلاغ عن أي سلوك أو حدث غير اعتيادي . حماية ممتلكات الشركة والحد من أي محاولات سرقة أو تخريب . التعامل مع الحالات الطارئة وفق التعليمات والاجراءات المعتمدة . الابلاغ الفوري عن الحوادث أو الاعطال أو المخالفات الامنيه . التأكد من اغلاق الابواب والمرافق بعد انتهاء ساعات العمل . التعاون مع الجهات المختصة عند الحاجة . الاتزام بالزي الرسمي والتعليمات والسياسات الداخلية للمنشأة. الكفاءات والمهارات المؤهلات العلمية: شهادة الثانوية العامة أو ما يعادلها . الخبرات العملية: يفضل وجود خبرة سابقة في مجال الحراسة أو الامن . الالمام بأساسيات الامن والسلامه التوصيف الوظيفي المهارات المطلوبة الانضباط وتحمل المسؤولية . القدرة على الملاحظه والانتباه للتفاصيل . حسن التعامل مع الاخرين . القدرة على التصرف السريع في الحالات الطارئة . اللياقة البدنية المناسبة للعمل. المهارات التواصلية  مهارات ممتازة في القيادة والتوجيه والتواصل الفعّال.

f7b7cbfb8851db0f.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Site MEP Engineer to oversee and coordinate all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) works throughout the construction lifecycle. The successful candidate will ensure that all MEP installations are executed in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes, quality standards, and project schedules while coordinating with consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams. Key Responsibilities Supervise and monitor all MEP works on-site to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and contract requirements. Review MEP shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and technical documentation. Coordinate MEP activities with civil, structural, architectural, and other project disciplines to prevent clashes and ensure smooth project execution. Conduct regular site inspections to verify installation quality, workmanship, and compliance with project standards. Monitor contractor performance and ensure MEP works are completed according to project schedules and milestones. Resolve technical issues and provide engineering solutions to maintain project progress. Ensure compliance with local regulations, international codes, health and safety requirements, and QA/QC procedures. Review and witness testing, commissioning, and functional performance of MEP systems. Prepare and review inspection requests (IRs), testing reports, snag lists, punch lists, and close-out documentation. Participate in coordination meetings and provide technical support, progress reports, and recommendations. Review as-built drawings and verify completed installations prior to project handover. Evaluate technical variations, change orders, and site modifications when required. Maintain accurate documentation of inspections, approvals, testing records, and site activities. Support the successful commissioning and handover of all MEP systems. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or MEP Engineering. Minimum 10+ years of experience in supervising MEP works on construction projects. Experience in commercial, residential, industrial, or infrastructure projects. Strong knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, electrical power, lighting, low-current systems, and building services. Familiarity with local and international building codes, MEP standards, and engineering best practices. Professional engineering registration or relevant accreditation is preferred. Technical Skills Proficiency in AutoCAD , Revit MEP , Navisworks , and Microsoft Office . Ability to review coordinated MEP drawings, BIM models, shop drawings, and technical submittals. Knowledge of testing, commissioning, QA/QC procedures, and inspection processes. Experience with project management and document control software is an advantage. Core Competencies Strong MEP coordination and site management skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management. Strong technical and analytical problem-solving abilities. Leadership and multidisciplinary team coordination. Attention to detail and commitment to quality. Time management and ability to work under pressure. Strong reporting, documentation, and organizational skills.

f705c8fa9319a701.description: استقبال الزوار والعملاء والرد على الاتصالات الهاتفية وتنظيم المواعيد وتقديم الدعم الإداري، بما يضمن حسن سير العمل وتولد انطباع مهني إيجابي عن المركز. المهام والمسئوليات: المهام والمسئوليات الرئيسية: استقبال الزوار والترحيب بهم بما يليق بالمظهر العام للمركز. مسؤولية أبواب المركز من خلال فتحها وإقفالها طوال وقت العمل. تسجيل واستلام الأطفال من أولياء الأمور أثناء خروج ودخول المستفيدين. حسن التصرف في المواقف الطارئة. الاستماع بعناية للزوار لضمان تقديم الخدمة المناسبة. التقيد بالزي الرسمي. الالتزام بسرية المعلومات وحمايتها من أي تسريب. تسويق الخدمات للعملاء. خدمة العملاء وأمين الصندوق: متابعة عملية التمويل للعملاء و التوثيق في النماذج المخصصة. التواصل وتأكيد حجز المواعيد. تحديث بيانات العملاء الزائرين في النماذج المخصصة. التنسيق مع الأقسام الإدارية الأخرى في الفرع. متابعة رضا العملاء. متابعة عملاء التأمين وتزويدهم بالإفادات. متابعة حضور العملاء وعدد الجلسات وتوقيع النماذج المعتمدة. إدخال اسم العميل للجلسات التعويضية على نظام زيبرا بوكس. حصر الفواتير على سدايا. متابعة إجراءات الدفع مع الأهل على نظام وتطبيقات الدفع والفواتير الكترونياً و يدوياً. التسجيل في كشف الخصومات للفرع. متابعة تسوية العهدة كل يوم 15 من كل شهر وترتيب ملف الفواتير. عمل مراجعة ورفع أموال لمحاسب الفرع. أي مهام أخرى توكل إليها من قبل الرئيس المباشر أو مهام تقتضيها حاجة العمل. الكفاءات والمهارات: المؤهلات العلمية: شهادة الثانوية العامة كحد أدنى، ويفضل دبلوم إداري أو ما يعادله. المهارات الشخصية: مهارات التواصل وخدمة العملاء. اللباقة وحسن التعامل. التنظيم والدقة في العمل. القدرة على multitasking وإدارة عدة مهام. سرعة الاستجابة وحل المشكلات البسيطة. الخبرات العملية: خبرة سابقة في مجال الاستقبال أو خدمة العملاء (يفضل). المهارات التواصلية: مهارات ممتازة في القيادة والتوجيه والتواصل الفعال. إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج Microsoft Office. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وحسن المظهر والسلوك المهني. القدرة على تنظيم الوقت والعمل تحت الضغط.

f707634af097ba5b.description: Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Scaffolding Supervisor to oversee the safe erection, modification, inspection, and dismantling of scaffolding systems across industrial and construction projects. Reporting to the Site Manager, the role is responsible for supervising scaffolding crews, ensuring compliance with safety regulations and project specifications, and maintaining high standards of quality and productivity. The successful candidate must hold a valid Saudi Aramco Scaffolding Supervisor Card and have proven experience working on Saudi Aramco projects. The ideal candidate is locally available in Saudi Arabia and possesses strong leadership and communication skills. Key Responsibilities Supervise scaffold erection, modification, inspection, and dismantling activities in accordance with project requirements. Ensure all scaffolding work complies with Saudi Aramco standards, company procedures, and HSE regulations. Coordinate daily activities of scaffolding crews to ensure safe and efficient work execution. Conduct routine inspections of scaffolding structures and ensure they are safe for use. Verify scaffold tags, permits, and inspection records are maintained accurately. Ensure proper use of scaffolding materials, tools, and equipment. Identify and mitigate potential safety hazards related to scaffolding operations. Coordinate with construction, maintenance, and HSE teams to support project schedules. Conduct toolbox talks and promote a strong safety culture among workers. Monitor workforce productivity and ensure work is completed within project timelines. Maintain accurate reports, inspection records, and daily progress documentation. Liaise with clients, site management, and inspectors regarding scaffolding activities and compliance. Qualifications & Requirements Diploma, Technical Certificate, or equivalent qualification. Proven experience as a Scaffolding Supervisor on industrial or construction projects. Valid Saudi Aramco Scaffolding Supervisor Card is mandatory. Strong knowledge of scaffolding standards, erection procedures, inspection, and safety practices. Familiarity with Saudi Aramco HSE requirements and permit-to-work systems. Excellent leadership, communication, and team management skills. Ability to read scaffolding drawings and project specifications. Candidates currently residing in Saudi Arabia will be preferred.

f77bf3f78702a950.description: HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking a motivated and skilled Road Engineer to support the design and implementation of road infrastructure projects. The Road Engineer will assist in the development of road layouts, pavement designs, and related civil engineering works, ensuring projects are delivered efficiently and according to specifications. Key Responsibilities Assist in preparing designs, drawings, and specifications for road construction projects. Conduct technical calculations and analysis related to road design and pavement structure. Collaborate with senior engineers and project teams to ensure smooth project execution. Support site inspections and monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with design and quality standards. Help prepare reports, cost estimates, and project documentation. Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, and stakeholders as required. Ensure adherence to local regulations and safety standards. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related field. At least 12 years of experience in road engineering and infrastructure projects. Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D, MicroStation, and relevant engineering software. Good understanding of road design principles, construction methods, and materials. Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under supervision in a dynamic project environment. Experience with projects in Saudi Arabia or Middle East is preferred.

Key Responsibilities Lead or contribute to engineering projects from concept and design through to execution and commissioning Apply advanced engineering principles to resolve complex technical, operational, and project-related challenges Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including project managers, consultants, contractors, and clients Ensure compliance with Saudi regulations, international codes, and health, safety, and environmental requirements Review and approve engineering drawings, calculations, specifications, and technical documentation Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and project performance Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers and technical staff Support project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management activities Liaise with suppliers, vendors, and regulatory authorities as required Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Chemical, Industrial, or related discipline) 7–15+ years of relevant engineering experience , depending on discipline and project scope Proven experience working on complex engineering projects within construction, infrastructure, energy, industrial, or oil & gas environments Strong technical expertise within your engineering discipline Familiarity with Saudi standards, international codes, and industry regulations Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (Arabic is advantageous) Ability to work independently and within multicultural, cross-functional teams Professional Engineer registration or equivalent certification is advantageous (role-dependent) Proficiency with relevant engineering software and tools Private Health Insurance Pension Plan Paid Time Off Training & Development

f706b4352a6d83c2.description: مطلوب محاسب زبائن (كاشير) للعمل في مجال خدمة العملاء والمبيعات. المهام تتضمن: استقبال المدفوعات النقدية والإلكترونية، تسجيل المبيعات في نظام نقاط البيع، تقديم خدمة عملاء متميزة، وإعداد تقارير المبيعات اليومية. يشترط الدقة في التعامل مع الأموال، مهارات تواصل ممتازة، وخبرة سابقة في مجال المحاسبة أو المبيعات.

f73b03cda1e00e01.description: Eram Talent is looking for a dedicated Liaisonman for Offshore operations to be a part of our esteemed client's team. The Liaisonman acts as the primary interface between the Operator’s drilling/workover team, the drilling contractor, and third-party service providers to ensure smooth coordination and execution of offshore drilling and workover operations. The role ensures all operations are conducted safely, efficiently, and in compliance with company and regulatory standards. Responsibilities Serve as the focal point between the Operator and Drilling Contractor during offshore operations. Coordinate day-to-day drilling and workover activities to ensure alignment with operational programs and schedules. Supervise and monitor drilling, completion, and workover operations to ensure adherence to the approved work program. Ensure that safety, environmental, and operational procedures are strictly followed at all times. Communicate operational updates, challenges, and performance reports to the onshore drilling management team. Verify and endorse contractor and third-party service company daily reports, job tickets, and timesheets. Participate in daily operations meetings and contribute to planning and problem-solving discussions. Ensure the availability and readiness of equipment, materials, and personnel for planned operations. Support incident investigations and recommend corrective actions. Liaise with logistics, marine, and procurement teams for the timely mobilization/demobilization of personnel and equipment. Minimum of 5 years of experience in offshore operations or liaison roles. Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field. Minimum 8 years of oilfield experience , including: Drilling projects (jack-up / semi-sub / land rigs) OR Workover operations (completion, intervention, and well servicing). Previous offshore experience with major operators or drilling contractors is mandatory. Strong knowledge of well control, drilling fluids, downhole tools, completions, and well servicing operations. Valid offshore survival and medical certificates (e.g., BOSIET, HUET, OGUK). IWCF / IADC Well Control Certification (Supervisor level preferred). Excellent communication, leadership, and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure in a multicultural offshore environment. Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

f7a7b1581e8a7b70.description: The Maintenance Engineer – Biomedical is responsible for ensuring the safe, effective, and reliable maintenance of biomedical and clinical equipment, as well as supporting broader facilities maintenance operations across KAUST’s community infrastructure. This role focuses on auditing, monitoring, and verifying the work of service providers, ensuring full compliance with technical, contractual, and safety standards. The engineer will manage both preventive and corrective maintenance activities and contribute to long-term asset lifecycle management. The position requires technical expertise in biomedical systems, asset performance evaluation, compliance with international and local standards, and effective use of CMMS tools (SAP/Maximo). Ensure effective and safe execution of preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance for biomedical and facility assets. Monitor maintenance activities to ensure alignment with KAUST standards, safety protocols, SOPs, and KPIs. Conduct audits, inspections, and technical reviews to verify service quality and compliance with regulatory standards (JCI, SFDA, CBAHI/SBAHI, IEC, HTM). Support troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Oversee calibration, maintenance, and performance verification of biomedical equipment in the community medical facility. Maintain accurate asset data in the CMMS (SAP/Maximo) and support lifecycle planning and preventive maintenance strategies. Coordinate with stakeholders and provide regular reports and recommendations to improve service quality and asset reliability. Demonstrate expertise in biomedical equipment calibration, testing, performance verification, and lifecycle management. Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering or related engineering discipline. Minimum 4–6 years of experience in the maintenance and operation of biomedical systems and general facilities equipment. Advanced knowledge of preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance methodologies. Strong understanding of biomedical equipment standards, device safety, and infection control protocols. Proficiency in Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), preferably SAP or Maximo. Strong technical expertise in biomedical equipment calibration, testing, and lifecycle management. In-depth understanding of international codes and standards related to facilities and medical equipment. Proven track record in contractor management, inspections, audits, and performance monitoring. Hands-on experience in complying with international and local regulations and standards, including: JCI, CBAHI/SBAHI, SFDA, IEC 60601, HTM Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) - Preferred Biomedical Equipment Technician (BMET) certification - Preferred

f7ba97a7ba25c02b.description: Join our dynamic team at Müller's Solutions as an SAP Basis Lead Consultant, where you will play a crucial role in ensuring the optimal performance and stability of our clients' SAP environments. In this position, you will lead a team of SAP Basis consultants, providing strategic guidance and hands-on expertise in managing and supporting complex SAP landscapes. Key Responsibilities: Oversee the installation, configuration, and administration of SAP systems in both development and production environments. Lead performance tuning, optimizations, and capacity planning for SAP databases. Monitor system health and proactively address issues to maintain high availability and reliability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements and implement effective solutions to meet client needs. Manage upgrades, migrations, and patches for SAP systems, ensuring minimal disruption to operations. Act as a mentor and leader for junior consultants, providing knowledge sharing and professional development opportunities. Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations and procedures. Stay informed about the latest SAP technologies and enhancements, evaluating and implementing best practices. Provide on-call support as required for SAP systems. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 7 years of experience in SAP Basis administration, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior consultant role. Extensive knowledge of SAP installations, upgrades, and migrations, as well as troubleshooting SAP environments. Familiarity with SAP HANA, S/4HANA, and other cloud-based SAP solutions is preferred. Strong understanding of database management systems (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server) and operating systems (e.g., Linux, Windows). Proven ability to effectively lead and manage teams, fostering a collaborative and positive work environment. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex technical challenges. Effective communication skills with the ability to work closely with clients and stakeholders. Industry-recognized SAP certifications (e.g., SAP Certified Technology Associate) are highly desirable. Proven track record of delivering successful SAP Basis projects on time and within budget. Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Exciting projects and innovative work environment.

f719931314d566d3.description: The successful candidate will work as part of the Public Sector team within the Markets function. As an Account Manager (AM) you will support the Account Lead Partner by driving the account management activities related to the business development and account's go-to market plan. The AM is expected to take a role in the development and execution of the account strategy, developing leads, support the pursuit of new opportunities and managing the relationships with the key clients while ensuring the quality of the proposals and submissions. All of which will require working with the team across the functional and solutions teams in ME and globally. Main Responsibilities • Proactively identifying and assessing the opportunities in accordance to the opportunity management framework and processes • Project manage the qualified opportunities with alignment and coordination with the bid and solutions teams and play an active role in developing the content for the proposal for the medium and large opportunities • Actively building and managing the relationship and interface with local and international client teams and solutions that provide the client with the optimum capability to illustrate their expertise. • Supporting the Lead Partner to develop broad and deep client relationships. • Working within the allocated account to achieve the account goals, targets and sales/pipeline. • Driving the development of the account plan and strategy and drive its execution. • Monitor account progress and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes. • Manage and drive the account-related, internal meetings. • Minimum 8 years of experience in management consulting business, preferably with a professional services firm. • Experience in the public sector • Bachelor's degree or equivalent • Fluency in spoken an written Arabic and English • Proven track record business development • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills • Strong communication skills • Health : The client offers medical insurance option to meet your needs through Premium Medical Care Coverage for employee & dependent family members. • Career Development & Trainings : The client always focuses on the career pathing & training of its employees. It gives you a platform for unparalleled learning & development. • Personal Time Off : Employees are entitled to take 25 days Annual leave & 11 days paid Holidays. • Money-Saving Benefit : The client offers several benefits, including Mobile Allowance, Schooling Allowance, Annual Air Tickets Allowance & Relocation Allowance. • Financial Matters : The client provides Housing Allowance in Advance for regular employees to support their home financial matters. • Competitive Salaries & Free Tax Salary : The client offers competitive & tax-free salary.
